verses.translation: He shall come into their midst as the land, as an eagle against the house of the Lord, because they have transgressed my covenant, and have sinned against my law.

translations.ron: Sună din trâmbiţă! Vrăjmaşul vine ca un vultur asupra templului Domnului!... Pentru că ei au călcat legământul cu Mine; împotriva legii Mele au păcătuit laolaltă.
translations.grk: Εἰς κόλπον αὐτῶν, ὡς γῆ, ὡς ἀετὸς ἐπʼ οἶκον Κυρίου, ἀνθʼ ὧν παρέβησαν τὴν διαθήκην μου, καὶ κατὰ τοῦ νόμου μου ἠσέβησαν.

verses.translation: They shall soon cry out to me, saying, O God, we know thee.

translations.ron: Cu toate acestea ei strigă: "Dumnezeul meu, noi cei din Israel Te-am cunoscut pe Tine!"
translations.grk: Ἐμὲ κεκράξονται, ὁ Θεὸς, ἐγνώκαμέν σε·

verses.translation: For Israel has turned away from good things; they have pursued an enemy.

translations.ron: Israel a dispreţuit milostivirea mântuitoare; duşmanul să-l urmărească!
translations.grk: Ὅτι Ἰσραὴλ ἀπεστρέψατο ἀγαθὰ, ἐχθρὸν κατεδίωξαν.

verses.translation: They have made kings for themselves, but not by me: they have ruled, but they did not make it known to me: of their silver and their gold they have made images to themselves, that they might be destroyed.

translations.ron: Ei şi-au ales rege fără voinţa Mea, şi-au pus căpetenii fără ca Eu să fi ştiut. Din aurul şi din argintul lor şi-au făcut idoli, ca ei să se prăbuşească.
translations.grk: Ἑαυτοῖς ἐβασίλευσαν, καὶ οὐ διʼ ἐμοῦ, ἦρξαν, καὶ οὐκ ἐγνώρισάν μοι· τὸ ἀργύριον αὐτῶν καὶ τὸ χρυσίον αὐτῶν ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς εἴδωλα, ὅπως ἐξολοθρευθῶσιν.

verses.translation: Cast off thy calf, O Samaria; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will they be unable to purge themselves in Israel?

translations.ron: Samaria aduce jertfă unui viţel; mânia Mea stă aprinsă împotriva lor. Până când pot să rămână ei nepedepsiţi?
translations.grk: Ἀπότριψαι τὸν μόσχον σου Σαμάρεια, παρωξύνθη ὁ θυμός μου ἐπʼ αὐτούς· ἕως τίνος οὐ μὴ δύνωνται καθαρισθῆναι

verses.translation: Whereas the workman made it, and it is not God; wherefore thy calf, Samaria, was a deceiver:

translations.ron: Că el este din Israel, un meşter l-a lucrat, dar el nu este Dumnezeu. Să fie sfărâmat în bucăţi viţelul Samariei!
translations.grk: ἐν τῷ Ἰσραήλ; καὶ αὐτὸ τέκτων ἐποίησε, καὶ οὐ Θεός ἐστι· διότι πλανῶν ἦν ὁ μόσχος σου, Σαμάρεια.

verses.translation: for they sowed blighted seed, and their destruction shall await them, a sheaf of corn that avails not to make meal; and even if it should produce it, strangers shall devour it.

translations.ron: Pentru că ei au semănat vânt, vor culege furtună; o semănătură care nu rodeşte spice şi care nu au nici un grăunte în ele! Şi dacă ar avea ceva în ele, străinii să le mănânce!
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἀνεμόφθορα ἔσπειραν, καὶ ἡ καταστροφὴ αὐτῶν ἐκδέξεται αὐτά· δράγμα οὐκ ἔχον ἰσχὺν τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἄλευρον· ἐὰν δὲ καὶ ποιήσῃ, ἀλλότριοι καταφάγονται αὐτό.

verses.translation: Israel is swallowed up: now is he become among the nations as a worthless vessel.

translations.ron: Israel va fi nimicit, va fi socotit printre neamuri ca un vas fără preţ.
translations.grk: Κατεπόθη Ἰσραὴλ, νῦν ἐγένετο ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὡς σκεῦος ἄχρηστον,

verses.translation: For they have gone up to the Assyrians: Ephraim has been strengthened against himself; they loved gifts.

translations.ron: Că ei şi-au îndreptat ochii spre Asirieni, au dat daruri de dragoste...
translations.grk: ὅτι αὐτοὶ ἀνέβησαν εἰς Ἀσσυρίους· ἀνέθαλε καθʼ ἑαυτὸν Ἐφραίμ· δῶρα ἠγάπησαν,

verses.translation: Therefore shall they be delivered to the nations: now I will receive them, and they shall cease a little to anoint a king and princes.

translations.ron: - Chiar când ei vor fi împrăştiaţi printre neamuri, Eu îi voi aduna laolaltă - şi ei vor înceta ca să-şi ungă regi şi căpetenii.
translations.grk: διὰ τοῦτο παραδοθήσονται ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσι· νῦν εἰσδέξομαι αὐτοὺς, καὶ κοπάσουσι μικρὸν τοῦ χρίειν βασιλέα καὶ ἄρχοντας.

verses.translation: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars, his beloved altars are become sins to him.

translations.ron: Efraim şi-a clădit multe altare - cu gând de păcat au fast ridicate!
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐπλήθυνεν Ἐφραὶμ θυσιαστήρια, εἰς ἁμαρτίας ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ θυσιαστήρια ἠγαπημένα.

verses.translation: I will write down a multitude of commands for him; but his statutes are accounted strange things, even the beloved altars.

translations.ron: Dacă Eu aş scrie pentru el o mie de porunci ale legii Mele, ele sunt privite ca ale unui străin.
translations.grk: Καταγράψω αὐτῷ πλῆθος, καὶ τὰ νόμιμα αὐτοῦ εἰς ἀλλότρια ἐλογίσθησαν, θυσιαστήρια τὰ ἠγαπημένα.

verses.translation: For if they should offer a sacrifice, and eat flesh, the Lord will not accept them: now will he remember their iniquities, and will take vengeance on their sins: they have returned to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things among the Assyrians.

translations.ron: Le plac jertfe şi ei le aduc, carne vor şi o mănâncă. Domnul nu le binevoieşte. Şi acum Îmi voi aduce aminte de fărădelegile lor şi voi pedepsi păcatele lor. Să se întoarcă în Egipt!
translations.grk: Διότι ἐὰν θύσωσι θυσίαν, καὶ φάγωσι κρέα, Κύριος οὐ προσδέξεται αὐτά· νῦν μνησθήσεται τὰς ἀδικίας αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐκδικήσει τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν· αὐτοὶ εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἀπέστρεψαν, καὶ ἐν Ἀσσυρίοις ἀκάθαρτα φάγονται.

verses.translation: And Israel has forgotten him that made him, and they have built fanes, and Juda has multiplied walled cities: but I will send fire on his cities, and it shall devour their foundations.

translations.ron: Israel a uitat pe Ziditorul său şi şi-a clădit palate, şi Iuda şi-a înmulţit întăriturile sale; de aceea voi trimite foc în cetăţile lui care îi va mistui palatele.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπελάθετο Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ ποιήσαντος αὐτόν, καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν τεμένη· καὶ Ἰούδας ἐπλήθυνε πόλεις τετειχισμένας· καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ πῦρ εἰς τὰς πόλεις αὐτοῦ, καὶ καταφάγεται τὰ θεμέλια αὐτῶν.
